description: Works out how much a puppy or young dog (8 weeks to 24 months) typically sleeps per 24 hours, how much of that its night covers given the household's bedtime and wake-up time, how many hours of naps are left for the day, and the typical nap pattern for that age. For questions about how much a puppy should sleep, how many naps it needs, or whether a puppy sleeps too much or too little. Gives typical ranges from vet and kennel-club guidance (Agria, AKC, Zoetis), not veterinary advice; a sudden change in sleep or lethargy is a question for a vet.

age.description: The puppy's age, in the unit below (8 weeks to 24 months).

language.description: The language the user is writing in, as a language code (e.g. en, de, sv, pt-BR, es-MX, ja, ar). The answer comes back in that language.

wake.description: When the household gets up, 24-hour HH:MM. Default 07:00.

name: calculate_puppy_sleep_needs
title: Puppy sleep needs
